caption:
McDonald's fries used to be cooked in beef fat. In 1990 they switched to vegetable oil, and Burger King followed within weeks.

In 2025 Steak 'n Shake went back to 100 percent beef tallow. Outback never left.

Seed Oil Tracker shows what your spot fries in. Free on iPhone and Android, link in bio.

caption:
Chick-fil-A uses two different fryer oils.

The chicken goes in peanut oil and has since 1964. The waffle fries go in canola oil, in their own fryers. From Chick-fil-A's own numbers, a large waffle fries has almost double the polyunsaturated fat of the Chicken Sandwich.

Seed Oil Tracker shows what your spot fries in. Free on iPhone and Android, link in bio.

#seedoils #seedoilfree #chickfila #fastfood
label: SOT C3 - chick fil a uses two fryer oils.mp4

caption:
In 2006 KFC announced a big change to its frying oil. It dropped partially hydrogenated soybean oil.

The replacement was low linolenic soybean oil. It took the trans fat out, but it's still a seed oil, and KFC fries in soybean oil today.

Seed Oil Tracker shows what your spot fries in. Free on iPhone and Android, link in bio.

#seedoils #seedoilfree #kfc #fastfood

caption:
Five Guys has used the same fryer oil since 1986. Peanut oil, nothing else.

From Five Guys' own numbers, a large fries still works out to 18.8 grams of polyunsaturated fat, because it's a huge amount of fries. The Little Cheeseburger is 3.3.

The whole Five Guys menu is ranked in Seed Oil Tracker. Free on iPhone and Android, link in bio.

caption:
The bottle labeled vegetable oil is not made from vegetables.

Seed oils are their own group: soybean, canola, sunflower, cottonseed and a few more. Olive oil comes from a fruit. Butter and beef tallow come from animals. Flip a vegetable oil bottle around and the ingredient is usually soybean oil.

Search Seed Oil Tracker to see which oil your food is cooked in. Free on iPhone and Android, link in bio.
